deploybot: PROD deploy starting for service=inference-runtime env=prod commit=6f4b2c tag=release/v3.6.2 window=22:00-22:30 UTC owner=@maria :rocket:

maria: Kicking off now. rolling across 8 clusters, 10% canary for first 5m.

josh: Quick question — is the previous pin preserved? we still need v3.6.1 pinned for rollback.

maria: yes pinned. rollback target: release/v3.6.1 (commit=4a2e9d).

sam: Copy — what’s the rollback command if the canary spikes?

maria: run: `rdeploy rollback inference-runtime --env prod --target-tag release/v3.6.1`

maria: fallback policy: auto-fallback after 3 consecutive anomalous health checks OR manual rollback. canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m steps.

elaine: Watching latency & error-rate dashboards now: https://dashboards.redwood/example/inference-runtime/prod :eyes:

oncall: on-call acked. will jump in at first alert.

josh: If we need to pin hotfix branch, point me to the tag name.

maria: hotfix would be `release/hotfix-2026-03-21` — don’t create unless we need it.

deploybot: Canary complete. health checks OK at 10% -> promoting to 50% (ETA ~6m).

elaine: 50% looks fine, p95 latency +2ms, error-rate unchanged.

sam: :thumbsup: no anomalies from our side.

deploybot: Promotion to 100% complete. deploy finished for tag=release/v3.6.2 commit=6f4b2c duration=18m status=SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. updating release notes and changelog now.
josh: Please add note about the batching perf improvement and new kv-cache tweak.

maria: done — release notes updated in the docs repo and in the ticket (TICKET-4421).

oncall: Monitoring for 30m post-deploy, will alert if anything degrades.

sam: Thanks all — closing the loop. :shipit:
